context: Interactive rotating orthographic globe showing 30 world cities colored by continent (categorical) with a day/night terminator line and pulsing city dots
first_impression: A polished cartographic display with accurate city coordinates and clear categorical encoding, but using hand-drawn approximate land polygons instead of real geodata.
what_works: City geographic coordinates are accurate and data-driven (spot-checked: New York, Tokyo, Sydney all correct); categorical continent color encoding is consistent, distinct, and paired with a clear legend.
what_doesnt: The night-shade terminator logic fills the interior of the geoCircle centered on the subsolar point with black — this is the DAY hemisphere, not the night side (logic is inverted, though low opacity at 0.35 masks the error visually); hover tooltip detection (line 425) does not filter for hemisphere visibility, so cities behind the globe can trigger ghost tooltips.
